theme_and_archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Adapted for 'Emergent Dark Sales Console'
design_philosophy: Mobile optimization of a dense desktop interface. Prioritize legibility, comfortable touch targets, and vertical rhythm while preserving the established dark console aesthetic. Functional parity is strictly maintained; changes are purely visual and spatial for <1024px screens.

micro_labels.reasoning: Tracking is reduced from 0.12em to 0.08em on mobile because larger text requires less letter-spacing. 12px is the minimum readable size on high-DPI phone screens.
micro_labels.usage: Status pills, overlines, secondary table headers, chart legends.

secondary_text.usage: List subtitles, timestamps, muted descriptions, input hints.

body_text.reasoning: 16px is mandatory for standard text and form inputs to prevent iOS Safari auto-zooming on focus.
body_text.usage: Main list item titles, standard body copy, form inputs.

kpi_numbers.reasoning: Numbers need to pop on mobile where scanning is faster and less precise.
kpi_numbers.usage: Primary dashboard metrics, deal amounts, leaderboard scores.

section_headings.usage: Card headers, page section titles, drawer titles.

page_padding.usage: Main container boundaries to give the UI breathing room. Replaces desktop tight padding.

card_gap.usage: Vertical gap between stacked cards/sections. Replaces desktop gap-3 to separate distinct logical blocks.

card_internal_padding.usage: Increases internal breathing room inside bordered cards. Prevents text from colliding with the rounded-xl borders.

list_row_padding.usage: Ensures list items (leads, meetings, payments) are physically tall enough for comfortable touch targeting.

rules.icon_buttons: Must be min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] (e.g., h-11 w-11), utilizing flex center. Keep internal SVG sizes at 20px but expand the tap area.
rules.chips_and_filters: Height must be h-10 or h-11 with px-4. Do not use desktop h-6 or h-8 micro-chips for filtering on mobile.
rules.list_rows: Entire row must be clickable (min-h-[64px]). Apply interaction states to the row, not just an arrow icon.
rules.segmented_controls: Each segment must be min-h-[44px], flex-1 (equal width) for easy thumb tapping without precision targeting.

kpi_cards.layout: Change from tight 2-col desktop grid to a spacious 2-col grid (grid-cols-2 gap-4) but strictly enforce taller minimum heights (min-h-[110px]). Alternatively, use a 1-col stack for primary revenue/pipeline metrics.
kpi_cards.typography: Increase numbers to text-3xl. Move the text-xs uppercase mono label ABOVE the number for better top-down mobile scanning.

charts.donut_revenue: Stack vertically. Donut chart centered (max-width 220px). Legend moves below the chart in a 2-col grid (grid-cols-2 gap-y-3) utilizing 14px text and 12px mono values.
charts.pipeline_bars: Increase horizontal bar thickness to h-3 (12px). Expand row container height to 44px minimum. Values flush right, labels flush left.

lists_and_leaderboards.layout: Use a clear horizontal stack: Avatar (w-10 h-10) + Vertical Text Flex (Title 16px, Subtitle 14px) + Right-aligned Metric/Action.
lists_and_leaderboards.spacing: Use gap-3 between avatar and text. py-4 per row. Add a subtle border-b border-[#232A35] between rows to guide the eye.

segmented_filters.layout: Full width of container, sticky below the header. Container: bg-[#161C25] p-1 rounded-xl.
segmented_filters.items: flex-1 text-center h-10 text-sm font-medium flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-[#9AA4B2] aria-selected:bg-[#232A35] aria-selected:text-[#F2F4F7] aria-selected:shadow-sm

navigation_tabs.layout: Horizontal scroll with hidden scrollbar (overflow-x-auto snap-x scrollbar-hide).
navigation_tabs.items: whitespace-nowrap px-4 h-12 flex items-center border-b-2 border-transparent aria-selected:border-emerald-400 aria-selected:text-emerald-400

forms_and_settings.inputs: Must use text-base (16px) to prevent iOS auto-zoom. Height must be h-11 or h-12 minimum. Use bg-[#0B0F14] with border-[#232A35].
forms_and_settings.actions: Use full-width (w-full) buttons for primary actions at the bottom of the screen or form (h-12).

micro_interactions_and_layout.sticky_headers: Utilize sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#0B0F14]/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#232A35] pb-3 pt-safe. This keeps context visible without consuming excessive vertical space.
micro_interactions_and_layout.active_states: Add active:bg-[#1B222D] or active:opacity-70 for list items, cards, and buttons to provide instant, tactile touch feedback (crucial for mobile CRM feel).
micro_interactions_and_layout.bottom_sheet: For the Deal Drawer or 'More' actions, convert right-side desktop panels into fixed bottom sheets pulling up from the bottom (rounded-t-2xl, max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto) with a 4px high, 40px wide drag handle.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, list rows, tabs, filter chips, chart legends) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='mobile-kpi-revenue', data-testid='lead-list-row').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this blueprint strictly using responsive Tailwind classes with the max-lg breakpoint (e.g., text-[10px] max-lg:text-xs). Keep the 'Emergent Dark Sales Console' color palette intact. Focus all changes on layout flow, expanding padding (p-4 to p-5), spacing gaps (gap-3 to gap-4), correcting typography scale jumps, and enforcing touch target minimums (44px) inside .js component files.
